title: squarespace.list_contacts
description: Input/output contract for listing contacts. GET /contacts on the contacts base URL (https://api.squarespace.com/v1/contacts). This is a 6th action, added beyond the 5 originally scoped in connector.yaml, once those five were complete — the mission board explicitly welcomes extra actions. It reuses infrastructure that was already confirmed rather than modeled fresh: the response envelope (top-level `contacts` array key + `pagination`) and the per-contact shape were already verified via get_contact's live testing and documented in get-contact.schema.json's `contactListResult` $def specifically so a list_contacts action could reuse them later (see that file's note: 'Use it if a list_contacts action is added later.'). VERIFICATION STATUS: the envelope shape and the `contact` object shape are CONFIRMED — the envelope against a real, empty GET /contacts response (fixtures/contacts.json, captured 2026-08-11 alongside get_contact's testing) and the per-contact fields against the one real contact record get_contact retrieved (see get-contact.schema.json's VERIFICATION STATUS for the full field-by-field breakdown, including the CONFIRMED absence of `tags`/notes and the still-unconfirmed `lists` field). What is NOT confirmed: this endpoint's own request/response behavior has never itself been called live — specifically, whether `cursor` on THIS endpoint behaves like list_products' (confirmed to combine with other params) or list_orders' (confirmed to exclude several params), or has some third behavior of its own. Do not assume either without testing this endpoint directly — see connector.yaml's known_limitations for the established pattern of cursor-exclusivity assumptions being disproven per-endpoint across this connector.

input.title: ListContactsInput
input.description: UNCONFIRMED — modeled by analogy to list-products.schema.json/list-orders.schema.json's `cursor` field, not tested against this endpoint. Whether `cursor` alone is accepted, what it excludes (if anything), and whether any other query parameters exist on this endpoint are all unverified.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's pagination.nextPageCursor. UNCONFIRMED on this endpoint specifically — modeled by analogy to list_products/list_orders, not live-tested.

output.title: ListContactsResult
output.description: CONFIRMED envelope shape — matches get-contact.schema.json's `contactListResult` $def, verified against fixtures/contacts.json (a real, empty GET /contacts response). Note the array key is `contacts`, unlike list_orders (`result`).

examples.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11 — the real captured empty-catalog response from GET /contacts, byte for byte from fixtures/contacts.json. The only real data point this endpoint itself has been exercised against so far; a populated response (and the per-contact fields within it) is inferred from get_contact's separate live testing rather than observed through list_contacts itself.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Cursor pagination envelope. CONFIRMED against fixtures/contacts.json (this endpoint's own real, empty-catalog capture). Duplicated from get-contact.schema.json's identical $def, consistent with how other schema files (e.g. list-products.schema.json) each carry their own copy rather than cross-referencing another file.

contactAddress.title: ContactAddress
contactAddress.description: Note this has no firstName/lastName/phone, unlike the commerce Address used on orders. Duplicated from get-contact.schema.json's identical $def.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Duplicated from get-contact.schema.json's identical $def (CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, against exactly one real contact record, retrieved via get_contact — not via this action). `tags` and internal notes are CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-16, to never appear in this response regardless of whether the contact has them. `lists` remains unconfirmed either way. See get-contact.schema.json and connector.yaml's known_limitations for the full methodology.

lastName.description: Observed as an empty string, not null, on the one confirmed record — kept nullable since that wasn't exercised.

primaryEmail.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11 (via get_contact). Replaces the earlier modeled flat `email`/`transactionalEmailStatus` fields, which do not exist on the real response.

defaultShippingAddress.description: CONFIRMED live, 2026-08-11, only as `null` on the one observed record — shape when non-null is UNVERIFIED. Replaces the earlier modeled `address` field, which does not exist on the real response.
